name: Riley Tan
headline: Senior full-stack engineer building LLM applications in Go and TypeScript

highlights: Built a RAG pipeline over 1.2 million shipping documents so support agents could answer customs questions with one search instead of five.
Designed an LLM evaluation harness with 400 graded test cases that caught three prompt regressions before release.
Moved document ingestion from cron scripts to a Redis job queue in Go, cutting failed imports from about 40 a week to 2.
Shipped a TypeScript and Go appointment platform used by 60 clinics across Southeast Asia.
Wrote the PostgreSQL schema and migration tooling the team used for zero-downtime deploys.
Mentored four junior engineers through code review and weekly pairing sessions.
Built React and Node.js web apps for 15 client projects, from scoping calls to production launch.

projects.name: ticket-triage
projects.summary: An open-source tool that routes support tickets to the right team with an LLM classifier and sends low-confidence cases to a human.

projects.name: gateway-lite
projects.summary: A small Go proxy that adds per-key budgets and response caching in front of LLM APIs.
